problem.forbidden: Your role may not do this.
problem.offline: No answer from the server: check the connection and try again.
problem.gone: It no longer exists (or belongs to another company).
problem.changed: Someone changed it meanwhile: it was read again. Check and try once more.
problem.invalid: Something in the form is not accepted: check the fields.
problem.slowDown: Too many attempts: wait a moment and try again.

lines.invoiceWhere: Matched with this receipt in Finance, on the supplier invoices page (it comes with the supplier invoice screens).

discStatusWords.OPEN: Recorded, not reported to the supplier yet.
discStatusWords.SENT: Reported to the supplier: waiting for the answer.
discStatusWords.AGREED: The supplier agreed: waiting for the credit or the replacement.

disc.summaryNone: Nothing wrong recorded on this delivery.
disc.closedReceipt: This receipt was reversed or cancelled: it takes no new discrepancy. The ones recorded can still be settled.

empty.title: No discrepancies
empty.body: Short, over, damaged, the wrong item or colour, a missing document: record it here with its photos, then report it to the supplier.

disc.reportHint: The report is a PDF without prices, mailed to the supplier on this receipt’s thread; its answer arrives there too. Open ones become Reported; one already reported goes again as a reminder.

notReportable.CLOSED: Closed: it is not reported or claimed again.
notReportable.answered: The supplier answered it already: settle it from its detail.

photo.openFull: Open photo {n} in a new tab

docs.ddtCapture: Photo of the delivery note of {number}
docs.ddtHint: The photo stays with the receipt, for the office and the goods-in tablet. The number and date are the ones typed at receiving.

none.title: Nothing is missing
none.body: These materials need no more documents, and the delivery note is recorded.

docs.recordResult: Record the result in Compliance › Tests & substances
docs.wantedHint: A lot stays in quarantine until its documents are there and the quality step releases it (Compliance › Tests & substances).
docs.released_one: {count} lot of this receipt is released already.
docs.released_other: {count} lots of this receipt are released already.

held.noManage: Your role may not record or settle discrepancies (inventory.discrepancies.manage).
held.noReport: Your role may not send the discrepancy report (inventory.discrepancies.report).
held.noUpload: Your role may not upload files (files.upload).
held.noReceive: Your role may not receive goods (inventory.receive).
held.noClaims: Your role may not prepare supplier claims (purchasing.claims.manage).
held.noImport: Your role may not run imports (imports.run and files.upload).
held.receiptClosed: A reversed or cancelled receipt takes no new discrepancy.
held.receiptCancelled: A cancelled receipt takes no photo.
held.kind: Say what was wrong: pick the reason or the kind.
held.ownReasonKind: This reason is your company’s own: pick the kind of problem too.
held.quantity: The quantity is a number above 0 with at most four decimals (12,5).
held.quantityUnit: Give the quantity and its unit together, or neither.
held.noteNeeded: This reason needs a few words: say what is wrong.
held.closedNoChange: Closed: what was found no longer changes.
held.sentNoChange: Reported to the supplier: what was found no longer changes. Record a new one if more was found.
held.sentNoRemove: Reported or closed: it is never removed; close it with what settled it.
held.photosNoRemove: It has photos: close it with why instead of removing it.
held.closedNoPhoto: Closed: it takes no more photos.
held.closeNote: Say what settled it, or why it is not pursued.
held.nothingOpen: Nothing is open to report: every discrepancy was reported or closed.
held.selectionAnswered: The supplier answered the ones selected already.
held.pickForClaim: Select the discrepancies the claim is about.
held.claimAnswered: Discrepancy {seq} was answered or closed already.
held.claimNoLine: Discrepancy {seq} is about the delivery as a whole: a claim needs the line (change it first).
held.checkFailed: The check could not be read: try again.
held.pickRecipient: Pick at least one of the supplier’s contacts.
held.contactsFailed: The request could not be checked.
held.pickDocument: Pick at least one document to ask for.
held.nothingWanted: The lots wait for no document and the delivery note is recorded.
held.noRequest: Your role may not ask suppliers for documents (inventory.receipts.documents.request).
held.requestClosed: A reversed or cancelled receipt waits for no document.

report.title: Send discrepancy report · {number}
report.subtitle: To {supplier}, on this receipt’s thread
report.reminder: reported before: goes again as a reminder
report.subject: Subject
report.messageHint: Leave it empty to send the standard text shown, in the supplier’s language; your words replace it.
report.what: The PDF has no prices. It is kept with the receipt and shared with the supplier; the open discrepancies become Reported.
report.preview: The PDF as it will leave
report.sentWhere_one: The mail and its PDF are on the receipt’s thread (Activity); {moved} moved to Reported.
report.sentWhere_other: The mail and its PDF are on the receipt’s thread (Activity); {moved} moved to Reported.

delivery.failed: Not sent: try again from the thread

problem.noContact: The supplier has no active contact with an e-mail: add one in Purchasing › Suppliers.
problem.selection: Some of these were answered or closed meanwhile: pick again.
problem.company: The company’s letterhead is not complete (legal details): fix it in Admin › Companies & sites.
problem.identity: No sending address is ready for this company: set one up in Admin › Connections & API.
problem.other: The report cannot be sent as it stands: check the receipt.

new.title: New discrepancy
new.subtitle: {number} · {supplier}
new.reasonsFailed: The reason list couldn't be read: pick the kind.
new.kindOwnHint: Your own reason: say which kind of problem it is.
new.quantityHint: Optional: the quantity and its unit.
new.noteHint: What you saw, at most {max} characters.
new.photosNone: No photo yet: a photo of the damage helps the supplier answer.
new.photosLater: Its photos stay; new ones are added when you save.
new.postedHint: The receipt is posted: the stock does not change; the discrepancy follows what is owed by the supplier.
new.openHint: Recorded on the receipt; reported to the supplier with the report.

body.AGREED: The supplier accepts it: the credit or the replacement is owed.
body.CREDITED: The supplier’s credit for it arrived.
body.CLOSED: Closed is final: say what settled it, or why it is not pursued.

settle.noteHint: Added to how it was settled; the supplier does not see it.
settle.claimNote: Claims that pursue it: {numbers}. A claim closes its discrepancies when it closes.

remove.title: Remove discrepancy {seq}
remove.what: Only for one recorded by mistake: it was never reported and has no photo.
remove.kept: The receipt’s history keeps that it was recorded and removed.

claim.subtitle: {supplier} · from {number}
claim.noteHint: A few words for the supplier (optional unless the reason needs them).
claim.what: A draft claim with one line per discrepancy, in Purchasing › Returns & claims: send it to the supplier from there. The goods stay here (a claim for credit or replacement).

request.title: Request documents from the supplier
request.subtitle: {supplier} · {number}
request.languageHint: The supplier reads it in this language.
request.what: The mail goes on this receipt’s thread: the supplier’s answer and its attachments arrive there.
request.sentWhere: It is on the receipt’s thread (Activity), where the answer will arrive.
request.toHint: Only the supplier’s own contacts with an e-mail; add one in Purchasing › Suppliers.
request.noteHint: Optional, at most {max} characters, set under the list in your own words. No price, no internal note.
request.previewHint: The standard text in the supplier’s language, with the documents you ask for and your note. It is not changed here.

refused.reason: That reason is no longer in use: pick another.
refused.kind: The kind does not match the reason: pick again.
refused.line: That line is not on this receipt any more: pick again.
refused.quantity: The quantity or its unit is not accepted: check both.
refused.moved: It was reported or closed meanwhile: it was read again.
refused.settleMove: It cannot move there from where it is now: it was read again.
refused.cc: A copy address is not accepted: check it.
refused.reportMoved: The discrepancies moved meanwhile: they were read again; check the report and send again.
refused.claimReason: That claim reason is not accepted (no longer in use, or it needs a note).
refused.claimDiscrepancies: These discrepancies cannot make one claim (another receipt, or no longer visible).
refused.claimLines: A line of the claim needs a quantity: give the discrepancy its quantity first.
refused.photoStore: The photo couldn't reach the file store: try again.
refused.photoType: That file is not a photo the receipt takes (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC).
refused.requestContact: A contact is not one of the supplier’s (or has no e-mail any more): pick again.
refused.requestDocuments: A document is no longer missing: close the request and open it again.
refused.requestNothing: Nothing is missing any more: no request is needed.
refused.requestClosed: The receipt was reversed or cancelled meanwhile: it waits for no document.
refused.requestNote: The note holds at most {max} characters.

notice.savedPhotosFailed_one: Discrepancy {seq} saved, but {count} photo did not upload: add it again from its detail.
notice.savedPhotosFailed_other: Discrepancy {seq} saved, but {count} photos did not upload: add them again from its detail.
notice.claimMade: Claim {number} made as a draft: send it to the supplier from the claim.
notice.ddtPhoto: Photo of the delivery note saved.

hideList.everyCompany: Every company (not for a hide list)
hideList.title: The tannery’s hide list
hideList.counts: {rows} rows · {toReceive} hides to receive · {before} received before · {errors} refused
hideList.received: Received as {number}: lots by dye batch, hides one by one.
hideList.notYet: Checked, nothing received yet: apply it in the import (Admin › Import & export keeps it).
hideList.against: Before {before} → after {after} of {expected} {unit} expected (up to {upTo} at ±{pct} %)
hideList.invoiceNote: The totals against the supplier’s invoice are checked in Finance, on the supplier invoices page (three-way match).

judge.short: Short of the order: the line stays open for the rest.
judge.over: More than ordered, within what the tolerance allows.
judge.overReason: Beyond the tolerance: every row needs the difference reason, else the list is refused.

status.FAILED: Stopped: see the import for why.
